questions.question: You are conducting an A/B test and need to create six different subject lines for testing. Which feature can you use to expedite the content generation process?
questions.explanation: The AI Copywriting Assistant helps expedite content generation by creating multiple subject line variations quickly.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about Winning Variant analytics is true?
options: Any confidence score below 100% is not statistically meaningful
The Winning Variant tab shows results of the best-performing variant from the first send
The Initial Test tab displays results of the second send, delivering the top variant to remaining audience
The Winner label identifies the best-performing variant after the initial send
questions.explanation: The Winning Variant tab displays the results of the best-performing variant from the initial send in the A/B test.
